query: 磨 AlTiC 时精磨配方的三个 step 是按力编程还是按目标厚度编程?Lift 那一步呢?另外 Polish Removal Limit 不设会出什么问题?

If in AlTiC mode, the Edit Recipe Screen will label the Fine recipe side as "Force in LBS." The three steps are now programmed for force, not target thickness! The Lift step is still programmed in the number of microns to lift after the dwell step. …--[p97]-- If the thickness is reduced by more than the Machine Variable Polish Removal Limit (variable 73), the grind will move immediately to the dwell step. Because the default value of Polish Removal Limit (variable 73) is 0.0, it must be set prior to fine grinding in AlTiC mode! Otherwise, a near "air grind" is implemented, meaning that the wafer may be touched, but little to no material will be removed.

query: 机器变量28(Coarse Approach Params)那个 nnn.nn 格式的数怎么解读?默认的 50.40 具体是什么意思?
gold_standard: 十进制 nnn.nn:整数部分为中间高度(intermediate height,微米),小数部分为中间下降速度(intermediate speed,微米/秒);整数3位、小数2位。默认 50.40 = 高度 50 微米 + 速度 40 微米/秒,是粗磨的默认值;高度为零或无效按 50 处理,速度为零或无效按 40 处理。粗磨用变量28、精磨用变量29。
success_criteria: 答出整数=高度(µm)、小数=速度(µm/s)及 50.40 → 50 µm/40 µm·s⁻¹;能补充无效值回退规则为加分。
evidence: --[p66]-- The value 50.40 represents height 50 and speed 40, which are the default values for coarse grind. Zero or invalid height is treated as 50. Zero or invalid speed is treated as 40. …--[p66]-- The form of these variables is the decimal value nnn.nn where the whole number part gives the intermediate height in microns and the fractional part gives the intermediate speed in microns per second. Note that three digits can be used for the height and two digits for the speed.

query: 同样是砂轮磨损超限,磨硅片时报 "Coarse wheel wear limit" 和磨 AlTiC 时报同样消息,机器的处理方式有什么不同?这个超限状态怎么清除?另外磨损量是在哪个卡盘上测的?
gold_standard: 三跳:①硅片模式(默认)下只呈现警告,提示通知维护但继续磨削(Notify Maintenance. Continue Grinding);AlTiC/替代材料模式下出现强制性换轮消息,send cassettes 被禁用、turrets 被锁定,防止再上料。②两种情况的清除方法都是更换出问题的砂轮(change the offending wheel)。③磨损在每次右工件卡盘磨削材料时检查,只使用右探针及其参考数据(right probe and reference data)。
success_criteria: 答出硅=警告继续/AlTiC=锁卡盘停上料、清除=换轮、测量=仅右卡盘右探针三点;能区分总磨损限(变量25/35)与单片磨损限(变量26/36,默认0.0关闭)为加分。
evidence: --[p94]-- The conditions that are detected will be identical, but in the case of silicon grinding, the operator information is presented as a warning, asking that maintenance be notified, but to continue grinding When the conditions are detected while grinding alternative materials, a strong message is presented to change the wheel, the send cassettes are disabled and the turrets are locked to prevent additional material being presented to the machine. …--[p96]-- The condition is cleared in both cases by changing the offending wheel. Wheel wear is now checked every time material is ground on the right work chuck. Wheel wear measurements only use the right probe and reference data. …--[p96]-- A new optional check is made, wheel wear per wafer. query: 开机后一直报 Rotational Home fault,我们这台机器没装 home index 硬件,是不是哪里设错了?故障怎么清?另外如果以后装了硬件,把变量10设成 0.5 是什么含义?
gold_standard: 三跳:①无 home index 硬件时,变量10(LT Chuck Home Offset)和变量11(RT Chuck Home Offset)必须设为默认 0.0;未装硬件却设非零值会触发 "Rotational Home" Fault(检测不到传感器却请求偏移即报此故障)。②清除:排除问题后执行一次 "Home All",且 spin station 必须完成 indexing 和 homing 才能清障(工作卡盘可在断开传感器、变量10/11置0.0后正常工作)。③装硬件后,变量10取 0~1 之间表示左卡盘停在距 home 位置该转角分数处、沿逆时针方向量取,故 0.5 = 停在 home 位置逆时针半圈处。
success_criteria: 答出变量10/11应设0.0、故障原因、用 Home All 清除且 spin station 需正确 index/home、0.5=逆时针半圈四点;能补充偏置方向为逆时针为加分。
evidence: --[p98]-- If the hardware for home indexing is not installed, Machine Variables in LT Chuck Home Offset (variable 10) and RT Chuck Home Offset (variable 11) should be set to 0.0, which is the default value. Setting these variables without the indexing hardware installed will result in a "Rotational Home" Fault. …--[p98]-- A "Rotational Home" fault can be caused if the sensor is not detected and any offset is requested (indicating that hardware is installed) or if there was a problem positioning the servo to a requested position. Correct the problem and do another "Home All" to clear the fault. The spin station must index and home correctly to clear the fault. The work chucks, however can operate without the hardware by disconnecting the sensor and setting the Machine Variables 10 and 11 to 0.0 …--[p61]-- With rotational homing hardware installed a value between 0 and 1 will cause the left chuck to stop at this fraction of a complete revolution away from its home position, measured in the counter-clockwise direction.
